North Wilmington Flat Ride (White Clay Bicycle Club)

Wilmington, DE · North Wilmington · Road

North Wilmington Flat Ride (White Clay Bicycle Club) is a road group ride in Wilmington, DE. It rolls every Tuesday at 6:00 pm.

First time? Here's the drill

Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it's a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before 6:00 pm. Tell whoever's leading that you're new.
Pace
Pace isn't posted. Ask the host before you go, or say you're new when you arrive.
Check
Look at @whiteclaybicycleclub the day of — that's where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the North Wilmington Flat Ride (White Clay Bicycle Club) group ride

A Tuesday evening flat road ride in North Wilmington from one of the region's oldest clubs. The club's Thursday North Wilmington Hills ride leaves at the same time for people who want climbing. Exact start point and pace are on the club's ride calendar.
